source: nflverse quarter history (2025-26), leave-one-game-out season per-half averages; catches used as the volume proxy (targets not in history); no historical live lines

bounce_back.definition: 1H rec yds < 50% of season 1H avg with 1H catches >= 80% of normal
bounce_back.note: Slow first halves usually stayed below season pace here; the over has NOT been supported historically. Live-line drop (required by the flag) could not be tested.
